snippet.title: Wood Watch Trailer
snippet.description: Due to you and your colleague's ignorance, the gates of hell have been opened, and demons are running rampant. You flee to the woods in an RV to try and buy yourself time, but you are discovered sooner than anticipated. Fend against the demons from 3:00 to 4:00 AM in a point-and-click horror survival experience. Survive the week to learn the story of what truly happened and find a way to fix the mess you caused. To learn more, check out the game's Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5249390/Wood_Watch/
